user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a bonsai pine. A bonsai pine in a shallow rectangular pot: a thick gnarled trunk with exposed surface roots, wire-trained branch structure fanning out in tiers, and dense clustered needle foliage pads. Miniature tree, aged bark. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
